reasoning: Waste management needs trust, calm, and organic tones (Archetype 1). To elevate Bincycle from a generic 'green' startup to a premium, modern platform, we apply 'Neo-Earthy' aesthetics: high-end editorial typography, rigid bento grids, massive negative space, and tactile, natural colors.
important_notes: All files must be .jsx or .js, not .tsx.
Use data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links).

headings.rules: Use for all H1-H4. H1 must be massive (text-5xl to text-7xl) with tracking-tighter and font-black for tension.

body.rules: Use for dense text, dashboard UI, and paragraphs. text-base or text-lg, leading-relaxed.

labels.rules: Use for overlines, small badges, and numeric data. uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-xs.

layout_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-8, p-16, py-32). Do not cramp marketing content.
layout_spacing.marketing_grid: Mode A: 'Tetris Grid'. 12-column bento, asymmetric spans (e.g., col-span-8 and col-span-4).
layout_spacing.dashboard_grid: Mode B: 'Control Room'. Dense, functional 1-to-3 columns. Every pixel purposeful.

buttons.style: Brutalist-lite: pure solid background, sharp corners (rounded-sm), text-base font-medium. Hover must explicitly set bg and text color.

marketing_nav.style: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F7F5F0]/70, 1px border-b border-[#D1CDBC]/50, sticky top-0, z-50.

marquee.style: Editorial Ribbon: Pale surface bg, dark olive text, slow speed, large gaps (gap-24). Monospace or Cabinet Grotesk text.

shadcn_overrides.calendar: Restrict to next 7 days using max/min dates. Override selected state to use brand.primary (#284226).
shadcn_overrides.dropdown: Use for Address Selection in dashboard. Remove default Vercel shadow, use solid 1px border (#D1CDBC).
shadcn_overrides.cards: For Time Slots in dashboard. Use HTML/Tailwind standard grid of selectable radio cards, not literal Shadcn Card component if too bulky.
shadcn_overrides.toast: Use Sonner for booking confirmation success message.

image_upload.style: Minimalist dashed border area (border-dashed border-2 border-[#D1CDBC] bg-white). Text: 'Drop image or click to browse'. Preview thumbnail on selection.

pages_wireframe_direction./: Hero: massive text, 'hero_truck' image (no heavy overlay). Editorial Marquee below. How-It-Works bento grid with 'circular_economy_3d'. Testimonials block. CTA with dark_section bg.
pages_wireframe_direction./about: Story-driven, large text. Incorporate 'eco_texture_bg' subtly. Bento stats.
pages_wireframe_direction./pricing: 3-tier pricing cards. Center 'Most Popular' card slightly elevated, use accent color for its CTA.
pages_wireframe_direction./help: Minimalist FAQ. Use Shadcn Accordion. Search input prominently at the top.
pages_wireframe_direction./contact: Two columns: Contact form (Shadcn Input/Textarea) + Office Info/Map.
pages_wireframe_direction./privacy-policy: Editorial, max-w-3xl, centered, lots of whitespace, typographic hierarchy.
pages_wireframe_direction./terms-of-service: Editorial, max-w-3xl, centered, lots of whitespace, typographic hierarchy.
pages_wireframe_direction./dashboard/book-pickup: Sidebar navigation (mock avatar in bottom). Main view: 'Schedule Pickup'. Sections: 1. Address (Dropdown). 2. Date (Shadcn Calendar). 3. Time (Selectable Grid Cards). 4. Notes & Photo (Textarea + File Input). 5. Submit CTA.

hero_truck.description: Clean, modern electric garbage truck in a bright neighborhood. Use in landing page hero.

eco_texture_bg.description: Abstract high-end texture. Use as a subtle section background (e.g., About page or CTA block).

circular_economy_3d.description: 3D geometric composition. Use in feature sections or How-It-Works.

real_photo_glass.description: Glass recycling container. Use for generic imagery if needed.

real_photo_bins.description: Recycling bins. Good for About page or blog visuals.

avatar_mock.description: Mock user avatar for dashboard sidebar.

accessibility.test_ids: All interactive elements, forms, and buttons MUST include data-testid.
accessibility.focus: All focused inputs must ring with border.focus (#284226).

motion.page_transitions: Lenis for smooth scroll. Framer motion for fade-in-up on major sections.
motion.hover_states: Buttons use crisp background/text color swaps. Dashboard cards elevate slightly (-translate-y-1) on hover.
